newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end lower on U.S. inflation data.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end lower on U.S. inflation data.

text.p: Swedish shares ended lower on Friday, pushed off intra day highs by a surprise jump in the core U.S. inflation rate for March.
The exchange's general index fell 0.53 percent to 2,632.66 in quiet trade with turnover of 2.95 billion crowns.
"It's been another boring day on the bourse," a dealer said.
Heavyweights telecoms group Ericsson and drugs major Astra fell in line with general trends. Ericsson slid two to 248.5 and Astra dropped 4.5 crowns to 343.
But Astra rival Pharmacia & Upjohn jumped 4.5 crowns to 276.5.

Pharmacia & Upjohn benefited from NatWest brokerage reiterating its buy recommendation on the share as it expects very positive news about the company's anti urine incontinence drug Detrusitol to be released during a weekend congress.
Banking group Nordbanken also ignored negative pressure and rose three to 245.
Fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz kept riding on showing strong first quarter sales figures a day earlier, up six to 1,054.
Vehicle maker Volvo slipped one to 195.
